Name: Tasty Treats
Author: Challis9000
Description:
Uses meat from Animal Husbandry Mod. Sells recipes at the Island Resort, so requires 1.5 or later (sorry, mobile users).

I wanted to get into modding and decided to do so by adding recipes I'd like to make in game. As I use the Animal Husbandry Mod myself, several of them use meat as I wanted to expand on the options I had to cook with the meat I was accumulating.

A collection of recipes for food and drink I wanted in game. Some get mailed to you at specific times, some are only available at certain festivals or locations.

Downloads.Description: More recipes! Also, Hopefully fixed the orange juice by removing it until I can actually remember how to fix it.

Manifest.Name: Delicious Recipes
Manifest.Description: Adds more meat based recipes to Stardew Valley, as well as several to use more fruit
